title: Strip-on-submit wiring in finalise_application untested — deleting it fails no test
evidence:
case uuid.from_string(vacancy.id) {
    Error(_) -> Nil
    Ok(vacancy_uuid) ->
      case
        sql.strip_draft_on_submit(
          db,
          vacancy_uuid,
          get_form_value(values, "email"),
        )  — and in server/test/integration/draft_integration_test.gleam:371-372 the stripped state is seeded directly: `let assert Ok(_) =
    app_sql.strip_draft_on_submit(db, uuid, "tenant@example.com")`. grep of application/gdpr/consent integration tests for `application_draft` returns zero matches.
detail: The strip SQL is fully tested and downstream gates (resume-after-submit, late-save) are pinned, but every test seeds the stripped state via direct SQL — no full-submission test asserts finalise_application actually calls it. A regression removing the call passes green; PII then lingers until vacancy close.
recommended_fix: Extend an existing handle_post_form integration test: seed a draft for the submitter email, submit, assert fields='{}', continue_token NULL, submitted_at set.

title: list_resumable_draft_tokens and the stage-2 reminder continue-link mapping have zero coverage
detail: The F3×E2 seam (spec requirement: reminder CTA becomes the continue-link) has its SQL filter (submitted_at IS NULL, token IS NOT NULL), email-lowercase mapping, and prefetch-failure degradation untested. Only the email template branches are unit-tested; the data path feeding them is not.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test seeding drafts (live, submitted, tokenless) asserting list_resumable_draft_tokens returns only live tokenised rows; awaiting_integration_test.gleam is the natural home.

title: handle_continue_link send branches and upsert-failure abort untested (PARTIAL coverage of P0 endpoint)
detail: Claim/mint/cooldown/clear SQL is fully covered, but the response-shaping branches around the Resend call and the abort-on-upsert-failure ordering are verified only manually, and no in-repo E2E exists to back the comment's claim.
recommended_fix: Land the referenced bug-hunt scenario covering save → continue-link → resume; optionally cover the upsert-abort branch by forcing a DB error (killed connection) in an integration test.

title: handle_resume closed-vacancy branch (closed page render) unpinned
evidence:
case application_handler.is_accepting_applications(vacancy) {
            False ->
              form_pages.view_closed_vacancy_page(
                vacancy,
                posthog_client.public_capture_key(config.posthog),
              )
              |> form_view.to_html_response  — the four handle_resume test call sites (draft_integration_test.gleam:277, 393, 412, 429) all use active vacancies; seed_closed_vacancy is used only for the save endpoint (line 149).
detail: Boundary state transition: a continue-link clicked after the vacancy closes must render the closed page, not a restored form. The branch exists but no test would fail if it regressed; the seed helper and pattern already exist in the same file.
recommended_fix: Add an integration test: seed closed vacancy + draft with token, GET resume, assert the closed-vacancy page (not the form-resume marker) renders.

title: No E2E coverage for the assembled save→continue-link→resume journey despite test-file claims
evidence: // is covered E2E by the canonical bug-hunt scenario for save-and-resume.  — but `find .claude/skills/bug-hunt/scenarios -name "*draft*" -o -name "*resume*" -o -name "*f3*"` returns nothing, `git diff b9bef7b..HEAD --stat -- .claude/` is empty, and no scenario mentions continue-link/save-and-resume/form_draft.
detail: Unit (JS serializer, filter, builders) and integration (handler+SQL) levels are strong, but the feature's level mix stops before the assembled browser journey both test files cite as existing. The stale claim will mislead future maintainers into trusting coverage that isn't there.
recommended_fix: Author the canonical save-and-resume bug-hunt scenario (save on step change, continue-link button, resume restore, strip-on-submit) or correct the comments to name manual E2E explicitly.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% at the state-transition level (save, claim/cooldown, resume, erasure, strip SQL, retention sweep, CSRF/body-size arms all pinned); three P0 behaviors PARTIAL at branch/wiring level. P1 ≈86% (12/14: reminder-seam SQL and prefetch mapping uncovered). Overall ≈85% (19 FULL, 3 PARTIAL, 2 NONE of 24 traced behaviors).
recommended_fix: Raise to PASS by adding the finalise_application strip assertion, a list_resumable_draft_tokens integration test, the resume-closed-vacancy branch test, and landing the cited E2E scenario.
